items.prompt: Create a premium Instagram advertisement (portrait 4:5) for the watch brand ARVEN. The product is the watch in the reference image: keep it EXACTLY as it is — same steel case, black dial with three silver sub-dials, numbered bezel, crown and pushers, brown leather strap with dark stitching. Do not redesign, recolor or add any logo or text on the watch. Scene: the watch resting on a dark cognac leather surface in a moody luxury studio, warm low-key light from the side, soft reflections on the steel, subtle depth of field, deep near-black background (#111214) with a warm cognac glow (#A0612B). Typography, elegant and perfectly legible, laid out like a high-end magazine ad: at the top, the wordmark ARVEN in wide spaced ivory serif capitals; below it, a large headline in ivory serif: "Le temps, bien porté."; a small line in spaced sans-serif capitals: "CHRONOGRAPHE · ACIER & CUIR"; at the bottom, a slim cognac pill button with the text "Découvrir". Spell every word EXACTLY with the accents. No price, no other text, no people, no hands, no wrist.
